fields.statement: Change set 'Workflow authoring' serves no intent yet. Its umbrella (Area workflows) serves anyone-builds and power-users-first. Which landed intent should it serve? / workflow-overrides says a built-in is replaced by name 'from the user's or the repo's own file'. The repo's .rhiza/workflows/<name>.toml already replaces a built-in. Should this change set add a user-level layer ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/rhiza/workflows/<name>.toml, between the repo's file and the built-in)? / What does `rhiza workflow describe <name>` show? / How does `rhiza workflow new <name>` behave?
